from samples import load_samples, ROWS
from journal import SampleBook


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_samples())
    book = SampleBook()
    book.add(rows[0])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1]
    book.add(rows[1])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_total_once():
    book = SampleBook()
    for x in load_samples():
        book.add(x)
    assert book.total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS)
